scope: read-only static review plus verification of the CPU gate and first protected GPU execution receipts; no model forward, training, GPU use, or evaluator execution by this reviewer

critical_findings.finding: Candidate checkpoint validation compares each frozen CUDA tensor directly with the preserved CPU parent tensor using torch.testing.assert_close. PyTorch treats device as an attribute, so the exact-value check fails on cuda:0 versus cpu before it can establish value equality.
critical_findings.runtime_evidence: execution/segment.stderr.log SHA-256 7576a4a183f0bda7d9be04c534b5933b4c30db3d0a75ab0fb8614245f00ce2e2 records AssertionError: The values for attribute 'device' do not match: cuda:0 != cpu at validate_state line 227. execution/report.json records worker_exit_code=1 and status=failed_no_retry.
critical_findings.impact: The first authorized head-only optimizer step consumed all 22 samples and completed, but validation then failed. No H1 checkpoint was published; only update_H0.pt exists. This is a validator/device bug, not evidence of a frozen-value change, numerical failure, or thermal stop.
critical_findings.required_state: Keep the failed execution and its source snapshot immutable. Do not auto-resume or silently retry. Any rerun must use a separately validated device-neutral exact comparison and must follow the coordinator's renewed budget/authorization decision.

current_post_failure_source.change_observed: A helper now moves both tensors to CPU before atol=0, rtol=0, dtype-checked comparison.
current_post_failure_source.device_regression_result: PASS_REAL_CUDA_CPU_FROZEN_VALIDATOR_REGRESSION: the original device mismatch was reproduced; the repaired full-state validator accepted all 92 unchanged frozen tensors; wrong-value and wrong-dtype cases were rejected.
current_post_failure_source.device_regression_boundary: The check used the saved CPU H1 diagnostic state moved to CUDA and exercised no model forward, backward, optimizer construction, or training update. It verifies the checker repair, not a restarted training segment.

passed_prerequisite_evidence.result: passed=true with cpu_threads=2, PYTORCH_NVML_BASED_CUDA_CHECK=1, exact continuous H1/H2 versus restored H2, four negative cases, optimizer_updates_published=0, candidate_training_started=false, and cuda_initialized=false
passed_prerequisite_evidence.boundary: The CPU-only gate compared CPU candidate and CPU parent tensors, so it could not reveal the cross-device attribute mismatch. Its recovery, mapping, RNG, schedule, and negative-case evidence remains valid within that CPU scope.

static_contract_observations: The name-derived contract selects exactly 42 head parameter tensors and 92 frozen non-head tensors. It maps the 42 head tensors to unique parent optimizer slots by name and binds momentum buffers by shape, dtype, finiteness, and SHA-256.
The intended schedule is five 22-sample updates labeled H1..H5, source schedule 1..5, source global 11..15, with global QAT count 30 to 35 and no automatic retry or continuation.
The optimizer is constructed only from the 42 trainable head tensors after model.to(device); the 92 frozen tensors are excluded.
The supervised worker waits for owned GO before CUDA setup and uses the inherited 75 C watchdog. The observed failure was not a temperature event.
The export path requires a one-sample 181-node exact integer trace. A later completion audit should additionally compare all serialized integer parameter fields with the final checkpoint package.

evaluator_interface.json_safety_fix: The evaluator now replaces already-validated parent Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG objects with a JSON-safe binding summary rather than attempting to serialize Tensor/ndarray values. A focused Tensor/ndarray regression is present; this reviewer did not execute it.

decision: The original launched source remains proven unsuitable for CUDA candidate validation, and its failed execution record must remain immutable. The corrected checker has now passed a real CUDA/CPU full-validator positive case and wrong-value/wrong-dtype negative cases without any training update. No restart has occurred. A fresh five-update run still requires the user's explicit budget decision because one optimizer update was already consumed, making the next successful five-update segment end at global budget 36 rather than 35.
